scripts.name: hello
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
echo "+---------------------------+"
echo "|  Hello from LayerDroid!   |"
echo "+---------------------------+"
echo
echo "User:    $(whoami 2>/dev/null || echo user)"
echo "Dir:     $(pwd)"
echo "Date:    $(date)"
echo "Device:  $(getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null)"

scripts.name: sysinfo
scripts.description: Full system snapshot (kernel, CPU, memory, storage)
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
echo "+------------------------------------+"
echo "|       LayerDroid SysInfo           |"
echo "+------------------------------------+"
echo
echo "-- KERNEL"
uname -a 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "-- CPU"
grep 'Hardware\|Processor\|model name' /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null | head -4
echo "Cores: $(nproc 2>/dev/null || grep -c processor /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null)"
echo
echo "-- MEMORY"
grep 'MemTotal\|MemFree\|MemAvailable' /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null
echo
echo "-- STORAGE"
df -h /sdcard 2>/dev/null | tail -1
echo
echo "-- DEVICE"
echo "Model:   $(getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null)"
echo "Brand:   $(getprop ro.product.brand 2>/dev/null)"
echo "Android: $(getprop ro.build.version.release 2>/dev/null)"
echo "SDK:     $(getprop ro.build.version.sdk 2>/dev/null)"

scripts.name: randpass
scripts.description: Generate a strong random password (usage: randpass [length])
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
LEN=${1:-20}
PASS=$(cat /dev/urandom 2>/dev/null | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9!@#$%^&*-_=+' | head -c $LEN)
echo
echo "Password ($LEN chars):"
echo "  $PASS"
echo

scripts.name: ipcheck
scripts.description: Show public IP and geolocation info
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
echo "Fetching public IP..."
IP=$(wget -qO- https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null || curl -s https://api.ipify.org 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$IP" ]; then echo "Error: no network"; exit 1; fi
echo "Public IP: $IP"
echo
wget -qO- "https://ip-api.com/line/$IP?fields=country,regionName,city,isp" 2>/dev/null || curl -s "https://ip-api.com/line/$IP?fields=country,regionName,city,isp" 2>/dev/null

scripts.name: diskbar
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
df /sdcard 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{ used=$3; total=$2; if (total>0) pct=int(used*100/total); else pct=0; bar=""; filled=int(pct/2); for(i=0;i<filled;i++) bar=bar"#"; for(i=filled;i<50;i++) bar=bar"-"; printf "[%s] %d%%\n",bar,pct; printf "Used: %d MB / Total: %d MB\n",int(used/1024),int(total/1024); }'

scripts.name: battery
scripts.description: Show battery level, status, temp and voltage
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
LEVEL=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/capacity 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
STATUS=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/status 2>/dev/null || echo "?")
TEMP=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/temp 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.1f",$1/10}' || echo "?")
VOLT=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/voltage_now 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "%.2f",$1/1000000}' || echo "?")
echo "+---------------------------+"
echo "| Battery Status            |"
echo "+---------------------------+"
echo "  Level:   $LEVEL%"
echo "  Status:  $STATUS"
echo "  Temp:    ${TEMP}C"
echo "  Voltage: ${VOLT}V"

scripts.name: weather
scripts.description: Quick weather report via wttr.in (usage: weather [city])
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
CITY="${1:-}"
URL="https://wttr.in/${CITY}?format=4"
echo "Weather${CITY:+ for $CITY}:"
wget -qO- "$URL" 2>/dev/null || curl -s "$URL" 2>/dev/null || echo "Error: could not fetch weather"

scripts.name: netcheck
scripts.description: Check connectivity to Google, GitHub and Cloudflare
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
check() { wget -q --spider --timeout=4 "https://$1" 2>/dev/null && echo "  [OK]   $1" || echo "  [FAIL] $1"; }
echo "Network connectivity check:"
echo
check "google.com"
check "github.com"
check "api.ipify.org"
check "cloudflare.com"
echo
echo "Done."

scripts.name: topproc
scripts.description: Show top 10 processes by memory usage
scripts.author: LayerDroid
scripts.inline:
#!/system/bin/sh
echo "Top processes by memory:"
echo
ps 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1{print $5,$9}' | sort -rn | head -10 | awk '{printf "  %8s KB  %s\n",$1,$2}'
echo
echo "Total: $(ps 2>/dev/null | wc -l) processes"
